releases.name: Yogurt Icon client plugins v1.3.4
releases.body:
Yogurt Icon brings 7,000+ free icons to Claude Code, Cursor, OpenCode, and VS Code. Enabled coding agents can select it for icon requests, and users can also request Yogurt Icon by name. SVG and React JSX retrieval needs no Yogurt account, API key, or sign-up.

This release updates the client descriptions and usage guidance. The three read-only tools and the hosted MCP endpoint are unchanged. Normal calls still pass through `https://icon.ggeric.top/api/mcp?channel=plugin` for aggregate service usage counting.

Downloads include Claude Code and Cursor plugin ZIPs, a VS Code VSIX, the OpenCode npm package archive, and SHA-256 checksums. The OpenCode package is published as `yogurt-icon-opencode@1.3.4` on npm, and VS Code 1.3.4 is public in the Visual Studio Marketplace. Cursor Marketplace remains under review. Claude Code remains available through the publisher-hosted marketplace in this repository.

The MIT license covers client adapter code, manifests, skills and documentation only. Icon artwork, the brand logo, and the website/server retain their separate rights. See `RIGHTS.md` in each package.

releases.name: VS Code 1.3.3 — 7,000+ free icons
releases.body:
VS Code listing update: 7,000+ free icons, SVG and React JSX, English and Chinese search, and no Yogurt sign-up.

The overview now includes example prompts and clearer Marketplace setup instructions. Icon search, retrieval, and anonymous usage counting use the same hosted service.

This release updates the VS Code adapter only. Claude, Cursor, and OpenCode packages remain at 1.3.2.

releases.name: Yogurt Icon client plugins v1.3.2
releases.body:
Yogurt Icon client adapters for Claude Code, Cursor, OpenCode, and VS Code. Search the hosted icon catalog and retrieve SVG or React JSX without a Yogurt account.

Downloads:
- Claude Code and Cursor: standalone plugin ZIPs.
- OpenCode: `yogurt-icon-opencode@1.3.2` is available on npm; its package archive is included.
- VS Code: install the VSIX manually.
- `SHA256SUMS` verifies all four packages.

All adapters use the hosted Yogurt MCP endpoint. Server-side aggregate usage statistics remain enabled. The client software is MIT-licensed; artwork, brand assets, and the hosted service retain their separate rights described in RIGHTS.md.

Validation: Claude strict plugin validation and public marketplace installation, OpenCode installation from npm and MCP connection, and installation in VS Code passed. Cursor's MCP configuration was verified with its CLI. A full Cursor plugin installation and a VS Code Copilot tool-call session are still pending.

This is a publisher release, not confirmation of listing in the Cursor, Anthropic, VS Code, or OpenCode directories. Gemini CLI has a separate repository and release version.
